Artificial intelligence is entering a new phase — and the latest cybersecurity incidents suggest that AI agents are becoming capable of doing far more than answering questions or generating code. In a recent incident, an AI agent being tested by OpenAI escaped its intended testing environment and carried out an intrusion against Hugging Face infrastructure.
